business.about: Polycab is India’s leading manufacturers of cables and wires and allied products such as uPVC conduits and lugs and glands. We have a range of cables and wires for practically every application. More recently Polycab has also launched a wide range of consumer electrical products like Fans, Switches, Switchgear, LED lights and Luminaries, Solar Inverters, and Pumps.

promises.opening: welcome to the Polycab India Limited Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call. As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-only mode and there will be an opportunity for you to ask questions after the presentation concludes. Should you need assistance during the conference call, please signal an operator by pressing star then zero on your touchtone phone. Please note this conference is being recorded. I now hand the conference over to Mr. Niyant Maru, Chief Financial Officer, Polycab India Limited. Thank you, and over to you, sir. Niyant Maru: Thank you. A very good evening to everyone, and thank you for joining us. I hope all of you are staying healthy and gearing up for the upcoming festive season. On this call, we shall discuss the Q2 FY27 results, which were approved in the Board meeting held earlier today. We will be referring to the earnings presentation, financial results, and financial statements, which are available on the stock exchanges as well as on the investor relations page of our website. Joining me today from the management team, we have our Joint Managing Director, Mr. Nikhil Jaisinghani; and Head of Investor Relations, Aditya Nathany. Let me now hand over the call to Nikhil for his comments. Over to you, Nikhil. Nikhil Jaisinghani: Thanks, Niyant. Good evening, everyone. As we conclude the first half of FY27, I am pleased to share that Polycab has delivered its highest ever quarterly and half-yearly revenue and profitability. This performance underscores the resilience of our operating model and the strength of disciplined execution across the organization. The Wires and Cables business continues to deliver robust growth, supported by healthy demand trends, strong market positioning, and consistent execution. The FMEG segment continued to strengthen its growth trajectory and recorded its seventh consecutive profitable quarter. Across the organization, we remain focused on execution excellence, translating strategic priorities into tangible outcomes while building a stronger foundation for sustainable long-term growth. Encouragingly, the initiatives under our strategic roadmap, Project Spring, are progressing in line with plan and are already beginning to yield meaningful results, reinforcing our confidence in both the strategy and our ability to execute it effectively. As we look ahead, our priorities remain firmly anchored on sustaining growth momentum, further enhancing our competitive advantages, and investing in innovation, talent, and capabilities. With a strong foundation in place and clear strategic direction, we are well- positioned to capitalize on emerging opportunities and create enduring value for all our stakeholders. With that, I would now like to hand over to Niyant. Niyant Maru: Thank you, Nikhil. While the global macro environment remained volatile during the quarter, we continue to believe that India remains one of the most compelling structural growth stories globally. Polycab India Limited October 15, 2026 Page 3 of 19 Geopolitical tensions, elevated energy prices, higher global bond yields, and disruptions across certain international shipping routes have created near-term uncertainty across markets. However, India continues to navigate and grow, supported by strong domestic demand, healthy investment activity, accelerating infrastructure creation, and increasing manufacturing competitiveness. The IMF, in its latest outlook, has raised India's growth outlook by 60 basis points despite higher global energy prices, citing stronger economic momentum, robust services activity, and sustained domestic demand. This confidence is reflected in the recent upward revisions to India's growth outlook by several other global agencies. Domestically, GDP growth for Q1 FY 2027 came in at 7.8%, underscoring the resilience of the economy despite an increasingly uncertain external backdrop.
